subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembers that Stone Giants are not to be rushed into a conversation.
source_quote: Thorin remembers that Stone Giants are not one to be rushed into a conversation.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam sighs and says, 'Something evil stirs in the Underdark. The rock itself cries in pain and horror, and a madness creeps from the blackest depths.'
source_quote: The giant sighs, 'Something evil stirs in the Underdark. The rock itself cries in pain and horror, and a madness creeps from the blackest depths.'

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam is cryptic in the best of times.
source_quote: Stone Giants are cryptic in the best of times.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam raises an eyebrow at Thorin.
source_quote: The giant stares at him. And then raises an eyebrow.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam offers Thorin the stonespeaker crystal as a gift.
source_quote: Before I go, I have a gift." His assistant brings a 19 inch shard of quartz crystal.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam is attuned to the stones and speaks their wisdom.
source_quote: This is what the stones tell me.

subject: Shal
fact: Shal is the Deep King’s new advisor, but Hgraam has never met them.
source_quote: I have asked to meet Shal, but they refuse.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir admires the stone giants’ subtlety and patience.
source_quote: They speak little. They ponder and then they consider their words.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices the stark contrast between the clean Duergar dwellings and the cluttered Derro slums.
source_quote: The contrast with the clean, perfect Duergar dwellings is obvious.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observes Droki’s unnaturally fast pace and lack of concern for being followed.
source_quote: Droki also doesn’t seem to care if anyone is following him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees Droki reveal a narrow fissure behind scraps of cloth and canvas.
source_quote: Droki lifts the scrap of cloth, pushes the gray sheets of canvas to the side, revealing a narrow fissure in the chasm wall.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido screams about the Council of Savants who promised freedom and failed to deliver it.
source_quote: He screams about the Council of Savants who promised freedom and failed to deliver freedom.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido believes he is on a divine mission to save his people.
source_quote: The divine mission requires that I go back! I must go and save them!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds Buppido building a shrine of bones and skeletons in a cavern.
source_quote: I didn’t expect you to find me here, with my shrine nearly finished!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz casts Fairie Fire on three of Buppido’s skeletons.
source_quote: Daz casts Fairie Fire. Suddenly, three skeletons are marked, and an ethereal glow surrounds them.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir plunges the cavern into darkness to disrupt the skeletons.
source_quote: Zalthir, never one to shy away from unusual tactics, plunges the area into darkness.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum prepares to turn undead but waits for the darkness to shift.
source_quote: Grygum, ready with his holy symbol, prepares to turn undead. Daz understands the intent—to disrupt the skeletons and disorient Buppido.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin draws his sword as Buppido becomes a direct threat.
source_quote: Thorin has his sword drawn.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido claims his faithful are finally honoring him and offers truth to Daz.
source_quote: My faithful are finally honoring me! Are you …? Yes. Yes, I sense that you are ready to receive my truth into your hearts!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes that Droki’s path is well-worn and marked with junk the Derro drops.
source_quote: Droki's path is very well worn and marked with junk that the Derro drops.

subject: Droki
fact: Droki is a courier trusted by all factions for safe passage through the Whorlstone Caverns.
source_quote: Droki can be trusted to deliver messages to the groups in the Whorlstone caverns and keep secrets.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notices the stench in the Derro slums changes from acrid and metallic to fetid and repugnant.
source_quote: As he passes through the gates, the stench in the air changes from acrid and metallic to fetid and repugnant.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees the Derro homes are crudely carved from the rock or holes in the walls, arranged in no apparent order.
source_quote: The homes in this part of Gracklstugh are crudely carved from the rock or are just holes in the walls, arranged in no apparent order.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes the floor of the cavern is carpeted with humanoid remains arranged in a spiral pattern.
source_quote: The floor is carpeted with humanoid remains in varying stages of decomposition, arranged in a spiral pattern around the cave’s center.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says, 'The divine plan tells me I must help you!'
source_quote: Buppido smiles, 'The divine plan tells me I must help you!'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin whispers, 'If you betray us, I will gut you.'
source_quote: Thorin whispers, 'If you betray us, I will gut you.'

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam says, 'The Deep King has tried to keep order and control, and the more he tries, the more the order escapes and tries to take the city from him.'
source_quote: The Deep King has tried to keep order and control, and the more he trie,s the more the order escapes and tries to take the city from him.

subject: The Faerzress
fact: Thorin wonders if the Faerzress affects his sanity and is connected to the spreading madness.
source_quote: Thorin wonders if this has anything to do with the Faerzress, which has affects his sanity.

subject: The Grey Ghosts
fact: The Deep King has become paranoid since Shal became his advisor, and his former calmness is gone.
source_quote: He and I would watch the stones grow. But something has happened to him. He has become paranoid towards old and new friends.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'What we have seen as localized appearances of demons is not localized.'
source_quote: So what we have seen as localized appearances of demons is not localized.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes that the widespread presence of demons is enabled by powerful magic.
source_quote: There is some kind of powerful magic that has enabled this.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam gives Thorin the stonespeaker crystal, which allows Speak with Animals, Speak with the Dead, and Speak with Plants.
source_quote: This is the stonespeaker crystal, with it you can cast Speak with Animals, Speak with the Dead, and Speak with Plants.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin learns from Hgraam that the best way to the Dreamlands is through the city of the Deep gnomes.
source_quote: Thorin learns from Hgraam that the best way to the Dreamlands is through the city of the Deep gnomes.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees Droki mutter a repetitive series of phrases: 'Droki is late! They will be so angry! Stupid, stupid, stupid!'
source_quote: Droki mutters a repetitive series of phrases at different volumes... 'Droki is late! They will be so angry! Stupid, stupid, stupid!'

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido leads the party to the abandoned Duergar guardhouses in the West Cleft.
source_quote: The duergar built a series of guardhouses to keep an eye on their derro slaves living in the West Cleft. These were abandoned...

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observes that the Derro slums are dangerous to anyone, and that is why non-Duergar are needed to navigate them.
source_quote: And now, why Errde Blackstaff and the Keeper of the Flames were so anxious to find a non-Duergar to come here is clear.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin understands that the Duergar would have to go through the Derro to reach the tunnels, triggering a bloodbath.
source_quote: Thorin also understands why they are underneath the city. To get to the tunnels, the Duergar would have to go through the Derro, and that would trigger a bloodbath.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes the Derro slums are dirty and cluttered, with homes carved into walls and piled atop one another.
source_quote: The district's dirty and cluttered streets clearly formed as dwellings spread and came together, not as a product of planning.

subject: Hgraam
fact: Hgraam says, 'The Deep King creates so many enemies. He used to be so calm.'
source_quote: Grey Ghosts? The Deep King creates so many enemies. He used to be so calm.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum sees a wisp of eerie fog float out of the fissure after Droki enters.
source_quote: Just as he disappears into the cavern, a wisp of eerie fog floats out.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz hears an off-key humming from a hunched figure building a shrine of bones.
source_quote: An off-key humming comes from a hunched figure working busily at something on the floor.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin charges forward and lands a solid blow on one of Buppido’s skeletons.
source_quote: Thorin, eager as ever, wastes no time. The dwarf charges forward, closing with one of the skeletons.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido charges with a hooked spear, but misses wildly.
source_quote: Buppido rushes at Thorin with a hooked spear but misses wildly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is hit by a crossbow bolt from one of Buppido’s skeletons.
source_quote: One skeleton, however, manages to take a shot at Grygum with its crossbow. Daz sees Grygum flinch as the bolt hits.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir’s darkness disrupts the skeletons, causing some to blunder blindly.
source_quote: Confusion reigns for a moment. Some of the skeletons blunder blindly in the darkness, stumbling around aimlessly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum holds his action, waiting for the darkness to shift before turning undead.
source_quote: Grygum holding his action, waiting for the darkness to shift so that more skeletons are visible.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum’s words of power overwhelm Buppido’s skeletal minions.
source_quote: The cleric’s words of power overwhelm the skeletal minions of Buppido.
